roleDefinition: Independently build, debug, test, optimize, and deploy responsive, accessible web interfaces from product requirements, visual designs, and API contracts under appropriate junior supervision.
evidenceSummary: Current hiring and professional guidance converge on platform fundamentals, React/TypeScript, responsive and accessible design implementation, APIs, tests, debugging, Git collaboration, performance, and deployment. Senior infrastructure and backend ownership remain outside the graduation boundary.
professionalPractices: work from design and API contracts
boundaries: Does not promise backend engineering proficiency.
Does not require a React meta-framework for graduation.
Does not teach senior architecture, infrastructure ownership, or advanced type-system theory.
Does not equate quiz completion with coding competence.
graduationBoundary: Independently build, debug, test, optimize, and deploy responsive, accessible web interfaces from product requirements, visual designs, and API contracts under appropriate junior supervision.

technologyDecision.state: Platform/React state models before external state libraries
technologyDecision.metaFramework: Not required; extension-only after graduation because core platform and React competence have higher beginner value.

sources.title: MDN Curriculum
sources.finding: The October 2025 curriculum emphasizes platform fundamentals, accessibility, responsive design, tools, environment knowledge, and soft skills; it explicitly warns about framework knowledge without foundations.

sources.title: GoodData Frontend Engineer Intern
sources.finding: Current internship expectations include React, TypeScript, JavaScript, HTML/CSS, build tools, REST/async work, communication, and Git/testing as valuable evidence.

sources.title: Quantcast New Grad Software Engineer
sources.finding: Early-career engineers ship customer features with React/TypeScript, tests, documentation, code review, operational ownership, and designer/product collaboration under mentorship.

sources.title: React Learn
sources.finding: Modern React learning centers components, JSX, state, events, data flow, Effects as external synchronization, and intentional state architecture.

sources.title: TypeScript Handbook
sources.finding: TypeScript assumes JavaScript fundamentals and exists to statically check value relationships rather than replace runtime validation.

sources.title: W3C WAI Tutorials
sources.finding: Semantic structure, labels, keyboard operation, feedback, and native controls are implementation requirements, not a separate late topic.

sources.title: Testing Library Guiding Principle
sources.finding: Frontend tests should resemble user interaction and avoid coupling confidence to component internals.

sources.title: Playwright Best Practices
sources.finding: End-to-end tests should verify user-visible behavior with isolation and resilient locators.
